name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.dedupList_toFinset
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} α] (l : List.{0} α),
  Eq.{1} (List.toFinset.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.dedupList l)) (List.toFinset.{0} l)

source.code:
theorem dedupList_toFinset {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) :
    (dedupList l).toFinset = l.toFinset := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x l ih =>
      simp only [dedupList]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [ih, List.toFinset_cons, Finset.insert_eq_of_mem]
        rw [← ih]; exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr h
      · rw [List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_cons, ih]
